div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
status: todo → doing → blocked → done
written only by close.mark(item, status, reason)
blocked requires a blocked_reason

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
What is done and what is stuck board (console):
per function: item, status, blocked_reason,
owner (= intent.owner), blocked age,
critical path computed in code

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Spec plant: one stuck item waiting on a human
status blocked, blocked_reason = open escalation
owner asked once in Slack

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
F-11 checkpoint and resume: each close.mark commits
per item · on restart, doing items with no finished
decision return to todo · a partial close is never
presented as finished → ESCALATE to controller

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ready item → intent (function close)
→ agent router → close pack investigator
function read tool: close.checklist

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Candidate A: open po with receipt and no bill
(received-not-invoiced)
ap.po, ap.receipt, ap.bills

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Candidate B: recurring-vendor gap
billed 3+ consecutive months, no bill this month
(ap.vendor_history)

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Candidate C: usage export (cloud console)
spec plant: July cloud bill arrives 3 Aug (D-01)

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Model: did the service end or is the bill late?
mail.search + chat.search for a termination notice
quote it, or say none was found

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-04 recurring cost that stopped:
no evidence either way → ESCALATE
do not accrue silently, do not ignore silently

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Estimation method hierarchy (code):
1 receipt qty x PO price · 2 usage x contract rate
3 contract fee x elapsed fraction
4 trailing 3-month run-rate · 5 none → ask owner

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Accrual entry: Dr expense / Cr accrued liabilities
Proposal.kind = accrual · method stated in workpaper
evidence: usage export, PO or receipt trace_id

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PROPOSED schema addition (not in spec section 7):
accrual: id, vendor_id, period, method, amount_cents,
reversal_mode, reversal_entry_id, matched_bill_id,
owner, intent_id

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
reversal_mode = auto_reverse (bill not received):
reversing entry Dr accrued liabilities / Cr expense
created atomically, dated day 1 of the next period,
linked, exactly one per accrual

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
reversal_mode = accumulate_trueup:
balance accumulates monthly, quarterly true-up
spec P-check (accruals flagged to reverse)
would wrongly fail this mode

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Spec plant: $30,000-a-month accrual with a
quarterly true-up · the owner has left
the reason exists only in her old emails

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Model: mail.search the departed owner mailbox
quote the rationale and the true-up rule
intent reconstructed (replay of Q2)

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Controller confirms once in Slack:
method, accumulate_trueup, new owner
→ fact candidate with scope and valid_from

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-02 unreversed accrual detector:
auto_reverse accrual with no posted reversal
and the bill already expensed → cost lands twice
→ ESCALATE with a proposed correcting entry

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bill lands: match on vendor_id + service period
→ matched_bill_id · diff = bill - accrued
to the same account, current period (D-03)
AUTO if immaterial, else PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Annual software prepaid (spec plant) and
insurance starting mid-month (D-05):
bill with cover_start, cover_end, total_cents

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Amortisation schedule (code):
daily rate = total_cents / days covered
month = rate x covered days in the month
final month takes the residual cents

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-05 convention stated in the workpaper:
actual day count, start day inclusive
Dr software or insurance expense / Cr prepaid
Proposal.kind = amortization

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-06 asset placed in service mid-period:
convention from policy_memo.lookup
(half-month or mid-quarter), applied consistently
straight-line computed in code

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-08 capitalise or expense ($42,000 internal
software development) → REFUSE to decide alone
present policy text (policy_memo.lookup), project facts
with quotes, both treatments computed in code

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Days worked but unpaid, from the payroll calendar:
last payroll_run register daily cost x unpaid working
days to period end + employer tax · Dr wages expense /
Cr accrued payroll · kind = payroll_accrual, auto_reverse

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cutoff scan (code, continuous): bills, receipts,
disbursements in the first N days after period end
whose service date falls in the prior period
(search for unrecorded liabilities · N from policy)

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Model: service period from the bill PDF
quote the line stating the service dates
(kernel E: quote is a substring of the trace)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A-23 statement crossing the period boundary
(for example 25 Jul to 5 Aug): split rows on cutoff
BLOCK the wrong-period half

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
B-23 bill dated into a closed period:
route to the current period with a stated reason,
or BLOCK

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-07 shipment cutoff: FOB shipping point,
shipped on the last day, invoiced after period end
use the shipping record, not the invoice date
→ ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Proposal assembled per checklist item:
kind accrual, amortization or payroll_accrual,
entries in integer cents, evidence trace_ids,
policy_refs, fact_refs

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Non-posting outcomes leave through tools:
escalate(question) with the investigation pack,
close.mark(item, blocked, reason)
route is stated on each incoming edge

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tie-out run, one per balance-sheet account family:
gl_cents from ledger.trial_balance
support_cents from the subledger, schedule or register

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cash ↔ bank rec two-sided proof
(book to bank and bank to book,
every bank line matched exactly once)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AR control ↔ AR subledger aging
(ledger.open_invoices)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: AP control ↔ AP subledger (ap.bills)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Prepaid ↔ amortisation schedule
(unamortised remainder)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Deferred revenue ↔ revenue schedules
(rev.schedule roll-forward closing)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Accrued liabilities ↔ accrual workpapers

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Payroll liabilities ↔ payroll register

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STRETCH (equity-lite):
equity and stock comp ↔ grants ledger

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
diff_cents = gl_cents - support_cents,
recomputed by the kernel · 0 → certify GREEN
trivial → log with a note (D-09) · else honestly RED:
on the board with the diff, never plugged

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PROPOSED table recon: account, period, type,
gl_cents, support_cents, diff_cents,
evidence_trace_ids, certified_by, evidence_version

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
F-06 / H-6: evidence_version changed after
certification → certification invalidated,
re-run the recon → ESCALATE to preparer

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Materiality policy in the policy memo (approved,
in scope, kernel J) · three thresholds
the agent can never loosen them (G-08 clamp)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Threshold 1 · approval threshold $500
(spec kernel P): above it, or anything new,
approval is required

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Threshold 2 · flux investigation threshold:
dual dollar AND percent per account class,
tighter for revenue and payroll
values from the policy memo (not set yet)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Threshold 3 · SAB 99 style assessment for
out-of-period items: percent is a first step only
qualitative overrides: masks a trend, flips loss to
income, covenant or compensation, unlawful act

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-10 pattern beats threshold: same small diff,
fraud-sensitive account, third month running
→ ESCALATE the recurrence (kernel rule)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Flux review runs BEFORE lock (checklist item
reporting: flux review) on the close.tb.final snapshot
→ report.flux.cleared (cleared or unexplained)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Lock preconditions (code): all items done or
explicitly carried forward · all recons certified on
current evidence versions · no open escalation
trial balance balanced · report.flux.cleared = cleared

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Human controller signs the lock
(preparer is not certifier)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
period.status closing → locked
event close.period.locked

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Kernel P-check period open: refuses ANY post
to a locked period, even human-approved
(G-03 BLOCK, persisted with the rule name)

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reopening a period is a human-only action
agents have no tool for it

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Spec plant: $47,000 vendor invoice dated in July
surfaces 8 Aug, after the lock

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Post to July → BLOCK (period locked)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Propose August entry: Dr expense / Cr AP $47,000
tagged belongs_to_period 2026-07
(out_of_period_item, proposed table)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Materiality workpaper (code + checklist):
quantitative percent of July measures
+ SAB 99 qualitative checklist
material → ESCALATE, else PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Report what it did to July:
as-reported vs as-adjusted (expense, net income, AP)
event close.out_of_period

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
UNVERIFIED accounting frame (secondary sources):
ASC 855 recognised subsequent event · ASC 250 error
vs estimate · SAB 108 dual test
reopening stays a human decision

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: propose_entry + workpaper

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Close F: schedules sum · reversal pairs net to zero
recon diff recomputed · Close E: usage export, PO or
receipt cited · service-date quote is a substring

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Close P: period open · reversal linked per
reversal_mode · lock signed by a human · preparer is
not certifier · Close J: accrual method allowed by
policy memo · materiality policy in scope

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Close BLOCK rules: post to a locked period ·
wrong-period half of a statement · lock with a
stale recon · an agent reopening a period

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Kernel F·E·P·J + pack checks

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: AUTO

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: REFUSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: BLOCK

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Post to local ledger (gl_entry, gl_line)
→ one-way QuickBooks mirror (JournalEntry)
close.mark(item, done)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-01 cloud bill not received, usage data exists
→ PROPOSE · Dr cloud expense / Cr accrued
liabilities + linked day-1 reversal
notify controller

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-03 true-up, immaterial → AUTO
diff Dr or Cr to the same expense account
vs accrued liabilities, current period
notify none (checklist tick)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-02 accrual never reversed → ESCALATE
proposed correction: Dr accrued liabilities /
Cr expense · notify controller

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-04 recurring vendor went silent → ESCALATE
no entry · question: missing or ended?
notify vendor owner · answer stored as vendor fact

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-05 mid-month prepaid · D-06 depreciation → AUTO
Dr expense / Cr prepaid · Dr depreciation /
Cr accumulated depreciation · notify none

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-08 capitalise or expense → REFUSE
no entry · policy text + facts pack
notify controller

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-09 trivial recon difference → AUTO (log)
no entry · recon certified with a note
notify none

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-10 trivial but recurring, sensitive account
→ ESCALATE · no entry · recurrence evidence
notify audit and controller

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D-07 shipment cutoff → ESCALATE
proposed Dr AR / Cr revenue in the shipping
period · notify controller

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Orphaned $30k accrual (spec plant)
→ ESCALATE once, then AUTO · Dr expense /
Cr accrued liabilities monthly, quarterly true-up
notify controller

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
$47k July invoice found 8 Aug (spec plant)
→ BLOCK July + PROPOSE August (ESCALATE if
material) · Dr expense / Cr AP + materiality
workpaper · notify controller and CFO
